Right on time, as always. I've got a job for you. A fellow stopped by not long ago with a lightning bolt symbol tattooed across his face. Nervous type, kept looking over his shoulder. At first I thought he was bringing trouble to my doorstep, but it turned out to be nothing. That's just... the way he is. He asked me to modify a Remington Model 870 with a laser device, a Magpul MOE handguard, and a tactical foregrip. It needs ergonomics at or above 60 and combined recoil below 500. He practically begged me to hurry, said someone was after him. Think you can handle it?}} ==Objectives== * Modify a [[Remington Model 870 12ga pump-action shotgun|Remington Model 870]] to comply with the given specifications ==Rewards== * +10,000 [[EXP]] * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.25''' * 165,000 Roubles ** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * Unlocks purchase of [[Tromix Monster Claw 12ga muzzle brake]] at [[Mechanic]] LL3 * Unlocks purchase of [[Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle]] (variant RPKT mod.1) at [[Ref]] LL2 {{quote|Turned out to be a fine shotgun. I'll pass it along to the client. Here's your payment. He paid in advance.}} ==Guide== [[M870]] specifications: * 60 Durability * 500 or less recoil * 60 or more ergonomics * Any [[Weapon mods#Tactical combo devices|tactical device]] (such as the [[NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser]]) * Any [[Weapon mods#Foregrips|foregrip]] * [[M870 Magpul MOE handguard]] ==Builds== '''This is one example of many possible configurations.''' ====Notes:==== * This build is based on a standard [[M870]] from [[Skier]] LL1. * The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
